verdict.rationale: Channel3 is agentic-commerce catalog infrastructure, so merchant-side attribution of orders to agents is a fair question, but the evidence shows no merchant-facing capability to attribute orders to an originating agent or to report on or filter transactions by agent. The closest item is an optional user identifier that lets the developer (the affiliate) attribute clicks and sales to their own end users. That is an adjacent, developer-side feature and does not deliver merchant reporting by agent.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
